thread:
Anya (ml-eng): quick sync — ran a small shadowbench with the multipass prefetch variant on the 7B-quant rollout, posting raw numbers below.
Sam (infra): nice, link?
Anya (ml-eng): https://internal/runs/9123456780 — results in the log. TL;DR: ~1.6x tokens/sec improvement, median latency +8ms, top-k quality (MRR@10) down 0.7 pts on holdout.
Leo (applied): can you paste the eval snippets? curious about failure modes.
Anya (ml-eng): pasted excerpt: 
```
model: ember-7b-q4f
variant: multipass-prefetch
samples: 5k
metrics: {throughput: 1600 tps, baseline: 1000 tps, median_latency: 42ms, baseline_latency: 34ms, mrr10: 0.742, baseline_mrr10: 0.749}
```
Sam (infra): 1.6x is great. Is that with batching on or continuous-stream?
Anya (ml-eng): continuous batching + KV warm cache from previous prefix. Multipass added an extra staging pass that precomputes attention for top-4 candidates.
Morgan (sre): ops-bot reported two spikes during the run (node 5 rebooted). Did that affect numbers?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: node/5 restarted at 9123456802 (rolling update). No errors during run; small perf jitter logged.
Jade (ops): can we re-run a clean holdout without the rolling update interference? prefer to merge results after a stable run.
Anya (ml-eng): yes re-run scheduled: queue id 9123456900. Also added a deterministic seed set to reduce RNG variance.
Leo (applied): aside from MRR drop, any qualitative regressions on long-form answers?
Anya (ml-eng): quick manual check: occasional shorter completions — looks like early acceptance bias in second-pass scoring. Example: prompt about summarization, baseline gives 5-sentence summary, multipass returns 3 sentences more concise. not catastrophically wrong, but lower ROUGE recall.
Sam (infra): is that consistent across quant levels? 14B-quant shows similar throughput gains but smaller quality hit?
Anya (ml-eng): preliminary 14B-q run (smoke) shows 1.3x throughput, MRR delta ~ -0.2 pts. So smaller regression there. hypothesis: quant-induced score peaking interacts with multipass ranking threshold.
Leo (applied): can we instrument the scorer to log candidate n-best probs and where pruning happened? need to see if the second pass prunes too aggressively for certain tokens.
Anya (ml-eng): added more logging: `prefetch.prune_threshold` and `multipass.rank_scores` to the run. config snippet below:
```yaml
multipass:
  passes: 2
  prefetch_k: 4
  prune_threshold: 0.12
  rank_by: combined_logprob
```
Morgan (sre): keep an eye on latency SLO — +8ms median is okay but p99 moved from 220ms->310ms in the noisy run. re-run clean to confirm.
Jade (ops): tagging infra: please reserve an isolated pool for the clean run (no rolling), 3 nodes, 2h window. @Sam
Sam (infra): ack, reserving pool `isolate-a` now. queue will use it.
Anya (ml-eng): after the clean run we'll open a small blind eval (50 prompts, human raters) to check acceptability thresholds. If MRR drop > 1pt or human accept < baseline by 5%, we abort rollout.
Leo (applied): add a targeted prompt set for summarization and instruction-following — seems where the regressions are concentrated.
Anya (ml-eng): will do. next updates after clean run (9123456900) completes. thanks :thumbsup:
Morgan (sre): FYI: setting alert if p99 > 280ms for that pool.
